review.reason: The observed change P1.F21.H4 adds Claude Opus 5.5 to the Desktop UI model selection options. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and compatibility update. review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the Claude Opus 5.5 model. The backend configuration, gateway routing, and API compatibility are not fully represented.
